comparison.objective: Move an untaped-bottom carton of cans to a shelf while preventing its flaps from opening; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support from below, flap containment and loaded transport versus fine tool alignment, rotary tuning and impact-cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Carton placed upright with every can retained and no spill versus two safe repeatable stops with no setting drift. Candidate rebound/overload/drift thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Load containment during transport is a different tested ability from mechanical commissioning.
